Name: MH Categories Chest
Author: mahsouto
Description:
[center][size=6][b]MH Categories Chest - Smart Item Organization[/b][/size][/center]

[size=5][b]What is MH Categories Chest?[/b][/size]

MH Categories Chest is an intelligent storage management mod that automatically organizes your items into chests based on their categories. Link item categories to specific chests and move all matching items with a single keypress! Say goodbye to manual sorting and hello to effortless inventory management.

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Category-Based Storage[/b] - Link unlimited item categories to any chest for automatic organization
[*][b]One-Click Organization[/b] - Press a hotkey to automatically sort all items into their designated chests
[*][b]Smart Priority System[/b] - Configure chest priority when multiple chests share the same category
[*][b]Dynamic Category Detection[/b] - Automatically detects all vanilla and modded item categories
[*][b]Uncategorized Items Support[/b] - Special category for items without a predefined category
[*][b]Clean, Simple UI[/b] - Intuitive chest editor with category selector integrated into the chest interface
[*][b]GMCM Integration[/b] - Configure all settings in-game through Generic Mod Config Menu
[*][b]Reorganization from chests[/b] - Now you can order all your chests following the system you have configured, it is disabled by default, it can be used by hotkey or when going to sleep
[*][b]Customizable label system[/b].
[*][b]Quick access to chests[/b] via keyboard shortcut.
[*][b]Dark mode - [/b]To provide better visual accessibility
[*][b]Chest management[/b] and [b]quick navigation[/b].
[/list]

[size=5][b]How It Works[/b][/size]

[b]1. Configure Your Chests[/b]
[list]
[*]Open any chest to see the edit button (gear icon)
[*]Click the edit button to open the category selector
[*]Select one or more categories to link to this chest
[*]Set a priority number (lower = higher priority)
[*]Save your configuration
[/list]

[b]2. Organize Your Items[/b]
[list]
[*]Press the configured hotkey 
[*]All items in your inventory matching linked categories are automatically moved
[*]Items go to the chest with the lowest priority number first
[*]If a chest is full, items overflow to the next priority chest
[*]Items without categories go to chests configured for "Uncategorized"
[/list]

[/list]
